plugins.description: Curated skills shelf: 22 skills selected verbatim from mattpocock/skills, anthropics/skills and heygen-com/hyperframes, kept fresh by a weekly CI sync that opens PRs against upstream changes. Curation manifest: curation.tsv.

description_i18n.zh-CN: 技能收藏夹：自 mattpocock/skills、anthropics/skills 与 heygen-com/hyperframes 逐字精选 22 个技能（逼问组、架构组、流程纪律、任务链、表达与创作），curation.tsv 为选型唯一事实源，CI 每周对上游重建并以 PR 提交变更。
